args.body:
命题：对任意正整数 $n$，前 $n$ 个奇数之和等于 $n^2$。用归纳法：记 $S_n$ 为前 $n$ 个奇数之和，则
$$ S_{n+1} = S_n + (2n+1) = n^2 + 2n + 1 = (n+1)^2 $$
基例 $S_1 = 1$ 成立；归纳步如上，结论对全部 $n \ge 1$ 成立（正文里的 ≥ 号会被排版层改写，量测 glyphsRepaired）；正文里另外保留一个裸 caret 写法 n^2，量测 proseCarets。

requiredLines.means: these are the lines the DELIVERY gate looks for VERBATIM in the rendered text (read them from `status.requiredLines` at any time): write each one exactly as printed inside some part, otherwise `final` refuses the paper after every part has been written

evidence.means: the pointers are resolved against the records face the moment the part is written, so a fabricated or mistracked citation is refused HERE instead of at render; this face resolves what it is GIVEN and requires NOTHING — an empty `evidence` list passes here, and the DELIVERY gate (gate "evidence", >=1 entry per part) is what refuses it later at render/final. Two faces, two questions: "do these pointers resolve?" (here) and "did every part file evidence?" (the gate)

evidenceGate.means: this part filed 1 evidence pointer(s) and every one resolved; the delivery gate asks the same question per part and will find this part covered

receipt.environmentMeans: this session has not asked the engine question yet (no compile/finalisation observed one): absent unknown, never "none installed" — `latexAvailable:null` names the absence of a verdict, and `toolchainAbsent:[]` means not-reported, not installed

paper.title: 前 n 个奇数之和 = n²

requiredLines.means: the verified track is empty, so this paper is required to quote no conclusion verbatim — the requirement grows as conclusions are promoted, so read this again before the final render

reachableMoves.means: the moves THIS state accepts next, read from the state machine: a draft takes part/advance and a reviewing paper takes review/advance. `final{decision:"revise"}` is the only door back to writing and it is NOT accepted here — it is accepted at awaiting-editor (and as the repair of a finalised paper that has no compiled PDF), so reaching it from writing means advancing first

editorReading.means: `value` is a ROLE word (not a seat id): "academician" means the seat in the chair slot signs, "office" means the office does; `source` says whether it was passed, normalised from a chair-seated member id, or defaulted, and `seat` names who held the chair when this reading was made

receipt.warningsMeans: `warnings` is HISTORY, not a verdict about the current state: each entry is tagged with the round it was written in (`（第 N 轮）`), and `forcedAfterCapRound` names the round whose cross-review hit the cap — a later round can agree and this list does not shrink (it is the record), so compare `forcedAfterCapRound` with the current `round` before reading it as now
receipt.roundMeans: every `round` in this view (parts, reviews) is the paper ROUND the row was written in — an ordinal, not an instant; `consult.requests[].at` is the subsystem clock in milliseconds (the only true time in the view — `paperClock` says whether that is the injected kernel clock or the counted wall-clock fallback), and the paper itself carries `createdRound`/`updatedRound`
receipt.partsMeans: each part slot says which ROUND it was written in (`round`); this subsystem counts rounds, it does not stamp a clock time on a part
receipt.reviewsMeans: each review row says which ROUND of the cross-review it belongs to (`round`); a row of another round is durable history, not a vote on this round
receipt.missingMeans: no compile is on file for this paper, so this list names the artifact ROWS that are absent (a write-stage paper reports md, tex, pdf, meta until render writes them). `archiveArtifacts` carries the same rows under their own name; `pdfCompiled.produced` is the file question, not this one

archiveArtifacts.means: this is the ARCHIVE reading: which of the four rows (md, tex, pdf, meta) are NAMED on the paper track. It is NOT what an action needed: `tex` is absent here whenever the paper was started with format "md" and render therefore never wrote a tex row, even after a successful PDF compile (RUN 252 / F72-7). Read `present`/`complete` here, and read the pdf block for "is there a compiled file"

receipt.mdOwnerMeans: a paper artifact is a LEDGER ROW (md/tex/pdf/meta), not an md file it owns: no paper row names `mdPath`, so there is no ownership evidence to report — null is the honest absence (the same null `vibe_v5_read_library` prints for a card that names no md file). Blueprint rows DO name their md file and carry `mdOwner` with bytes/sha256 read from the disk (RUN 255 / TB-2613)

paperClock.means: this subsystem reads the kernel clock, so the paper timestamps are reproducible

receipt.paperClockMeans: the clock THIS paper face used: `injected:true` + `source:"kernel-clock"` means every paper timestamp came from the injected kernel clock (reproducible); `source:"wall-clock"` names the counted fallback, so no receipt can mistake a wall stamp for an injected one
